_comment: OPTIONAL override list. Dungeons / off-map areas are now freed AUTOMATICALLY by a coordinate rule in ChunkBlazerPlugin.isFreeRegion: any region whose regionY is outside the overworld surface band 39-64 (world y 2496-4159) is a free dungeon. That auto-covers all underground/relocated/instanced content, including future additions, with no dataset gaps. Only add a region ID below to force-free an oddball the coordinate rule misses (e.g. an off-map area that happens to sit inside the surface band). NOTE: charter ports are NOT freed here — they're unlock-on-demand (free / 0-cost, shown as a yellow 'unlockable' outline); sailing into one or clicking it unlocks it for free and rolls its tasks (see ChunkBlazerPlugin.isCharterRegion / unlockRegionFree). A one-time migration (migrateStripSeededCharterChunks) removes ports seeded by older builds.
